title: Microsoft.Entra/policies/appManagementPolicies
description: A custom app management policy (appManagementPolicy): credential restrictions for the applications and service principals it is assigned to with their appManagementPolicies edge (one per object). The resource name is the displayName; it is looked up by displayName on every run (more than one match is an error). Restrictions it leaves out fall back to the tenant default policy.

displayName.description: Set from the resource name; declaring it is only allowed when it equals the name.

restrictions.description: The restrictions (customAppManagementConfiguration). Undeclared members keep their live values.

passwordCredentials.description: Password and symmetric key restrictions, compared as a set keyed by restrictionType.

restrictionType.description: passwordCredentials: passwordAddition, passwordLifetime, symmetricKeyAddition, symmetricKeyLifetime, customPasswordAddition; keyCredentials: asymmetricKeyLifetime, trustedCertificateAuthority. The key of the set.

state.description: enabled or disabled (a disabled restriction exempts the object).

maxLifetime.description: Lifetime restrictions: the maximum lifetime as an ISO 8601 duration, for example P90D.

restrictForAppsCreatedAfterDateTime.description: Applies to applications created after this date (ISO 8601).

certificateBasedApplicationConfiguration.description: trustedCertificateAuthority: the certificate based application configuration ids.

keyCredentials.description: Certificate restrictions, compared as a set keyed by restrictionType.

restrictionType.description: passwordCredentials: passwordAddition, passwordLifetime, symmetricKeyAddition, symmetricKeyLifetime, customPasswordAddition; keyCredentials: asymmetricKeyLifetime, trustedCertificateAuthority. The key of the set.

state.description: enabled or disabled (a disabled restriction exempts the object).

maxLifetime.description: Lifetime restrictions: the maximum lifetime as an ISO 8601 duration, for example P90D.

restrictForAppsCreatedAfterDateTime.description: Applies to applications created after this date (ISO 8601).

certificateBasedApplicationConfiguration.description: trustedCertificateAuthority: the certificate based application configuration ids.

applicationRestrictions.description: Custom policies: application restrictions, for example identifierUris.nonDefaultUriAddition.

permissions.notes: Learn (appmanagementpolicy-post, -update, -delete, -post-appliesto, tenantappmanagementpolicy-update): Policy.ReadWrite.ApplicationConfiguration is the least privileged write permission (delegated and application), with Cloud Application Administrator or Application Administrator as the least privileged roles; reads need Policy.Read.All (Global Reader). The Entra how-to (configure-app-management-policies) asks for Security Administrator in addition. Learn states no licence requirement on these pages.
